prompt: istio TracingServiceName APP_LABEL_AND_NAMESPACE missing app label fallback
answer:
With `TracingServiceName: APP_LABEL_AND_NAMESPACE`, if the workload has no `app` label, Istio falls back to `istio-proxy` for the service name. The service name is formed with the workload namespace, so it is effectively:

```text
istio-proxy.<namespace>
```

The setting is configured under `mesh.defaultConfig` in the Istio `ConfigMap`.
